subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should exhausted context overflow enter the existing model fallback chain, and should a successful larger-context fallback remain temporary or become the session model?
rationale: Source inspection can establish the missing path, but only maintainers can choose the cross-model replay and persistence contract because it affects side-effect safety, session state, provider routing, and future turns.

options.title: Guarded temporary fallback
options.body: After compaction and truncation fail, retry a headroom-qualified fallback only when replay is safe, and keep the configured primary unchanged for future turns.

options.title: Keep compaction-only policy
options.body: Do not cross models automatically; improve the blocked-state recovery UI and document manual model switching or session reset.

options.title: Adopt preflight model routing
options.body: Select a sufficiently large model before submission based on estimated context size, accepting a broader routing-policy and observability change.

recommendation.title: Guarded temporary fallback
recommendation.body: After compaction and truncation fail, retry a headroom-qualified fallback only when replay is safe, and keep the configured primary unchanged for future turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and recent work across both fallback and embedded-runner boundaries make this the strongest available routing candidate.
